Wordsmith Learning Hub Recruits Senior Digital Marketing Manager for Tamil Edtech Sector

Overview of the Position

Wordsmith Learning Hub has listed a vacancy for a Senior Digital Marketing Manager specializing in the Tamil Edtech industry. The role also encompasses responsibilities as the Head of the Marketing Department. The position is structured as a full-time, 100% remote opportunity based out of Singapore, though accessible via professional networks in regions like India.

Role Requirements and Responsibilities

The organization is looking for a results-driven digital marketing and operations lead with a background specific to the education, school, or EdTech sector. Key requirements and duties outlined in the listing include:

  • Sector Experience: Relevant background in education, schools, or the EdTech industry is mandatory.
  • Language Proficiency: Fluency in speaking, reading, and writing both Tamil and English.
  • Technical Skills: Proven experience in WordPress management (creating landing pages and maintaining both dynamic and static websites), Meta Ads, Google Ads, lead generation, and content writing. Familiarity with SEO, GEO, AEO, and SEM is noted as a plus.
  • Experience Level: Less than 10 years of digital marketing experience.
  • Core Duties: Developing digital marketing strategies, building brand presence, driving customer acquisition, generating quality leads, boosting enrolments, and creating operational standard operating procedures (SOPs).
  • Leadership: Managing and recruiting a marketing team, conducting training, and contributing to overall business growth within a startup environment.

Compensation and Benefits

According to the official posting, the monthly compensation package ranges from 60,000 INR to 1 Lakh INR (LPA), with the note that salary is not a constraint for the right candidate. Additional benefits include performance-based career progression and standard company perks.

Practical Implications and Verification

For professionals evaluating this opening, the role requires a specialized skill set combining regional language fluency (Tamil) with technical digital marketing operations and team management in a fast-paced startup ecosystem.

  • Confirmed Facts: Job title, employer (Wordsmith Learning Hub), remote work setup, required language proficiencies, WordPress and EdTech experience prerequisites, and the stated salary range (60K INR to 1 LPA).
  • Unknowns and Missing Details: The application deadline, specific selection process steps, and exact hiring timelines are not specified in the source text.
  • How to Verify: Interested candidates can review the complete listing details, check company updates, and apply directly through the official [LinkedIn Job Posting](https://in.linkedin.com/jobs/view/senior-digital-marketing-manager-tamil-edtech-industry-at-wordsmith-learning-hub-4483638147).
